maya_marketing: Final preflight for Friday's 'Inference in Prod' webinar. Need: reg page QA (GDPR + timezones), Zoom recording settings, and post-event lead routing. Owners?

eli_ops: I'll handle Zoom. Settings: webinar mode, cloud recording (mp4 + separate audio tracks), auto-transcript (SRT), co-hosts enabled, waiting room on. Retention 60 days.

carmen_partners: Partner copy done; added partner opt-in checkbox. Please confirm it maps to HubSpot field `partner_consent`.

liam_growth: On reg page A/B: CTA A = "Attend Live" vs CTA B = "Reserve My Spot (Replay)". We'll test for conversion to live attendance. Also add utm params: utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=inference_prod_may.

maya_marketing: Good. Eli can you enable a field on the reg form: "Product area of interest" -> values map to AE queues?

eli_ops: Added. Zapier flow: registrant -> enrich -> hubspot upsert -> property routing. Zap test passed (zap-bot confirms).

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created. Meeting ID 876543219. Cloud recording and auto-transcription enabled. Link will post to #marketing when processed.

liam_growth: Post-event plan: within 4h publish internal MP4 + SRT to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-05-14/, clips (top 3) by 8h, public replay with captions at 24h. Sales routing: live attendees with interest flag -> AE alert within 12h.

maya_marketing: Who monitors chat and who confirms recording link?

eli_ops: I'll confirm recording + transcript within 1h of end. @liam_growth will monitor chat.

maya_marketing: Last note: PII scrub on transcripts before public posting. I'll run QA.

liam_growth: All green from growth side. See you at rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
